## About

Moritz Vollmer is based in Cologne, Germany. He works on frontend development, WordPress development, accessible interfaces, technical SEO, generative engine optimization, digital marketing, sustainable web projects, and clean implementation details. SEO, GEO, and marketing are areas of specialization and professional development; his current professional title remains Frontend Specialist and WordPress Developer.
